title: First date nerves pack
old_caption: Seven outfits, a rehearsed laugh on take six, and a megaphone pep talk from Aries. The rare item: a date who practiced the laugh too. What's in your nerves pack?

title: Hopeless romantic pack
old_caption: Hopeless romantic starter pack: window gazing, love-letter draft v16, a playlist called 'us?', and the rare item, a talk card that ends in 'wait, same?' How many do you own?

title: POV: your crush says my sign?
old_caption: Your crush says 'my sign? guess.' You guess all twelve and get twelve red X's, including Libra. They were Libra. You said Libra. Has a crush ever done this to you?

title: POV: your date asks your moon sign and you don't know it
old_caption: POV: your date asks your moon sign. Sun, sure. Rising, probably. Moon, total blank. The stars whispered the answer to both of you. Do you actually know your moon sign?

title: POV
old_caption: POV: you're reading your friend's texts over their shoulder. 'hey' is too cold, 'HEYYY omg hiii' is too much, then they write the perfect one and won't hit send. Who's your send-it friend?

title: POV: you're a talk card about to be answered
old_caption: POV: you're a talk card asking 'what's your comfort meal?' and Taurus is holding you, thinking. Don't skip me. Don't skip me. Then: 'my grandma's soup. I'll make you some.' Your answer?

title: POV
old_caption: Three straws, the middle spot in the group selfie, and now they're matchmaking for you. Third wheeling has never been this cozy. Send this to the couple who always saves you a seat.

title: Rating the first meal they cooked
old_caption: The pasta crunched. The sauce was smoky. Dessert was store-bought, sorry. And Taurus still scored it eleven out of ten for the heart drawn in the sauce. Rate the first meal someone cooked for you.

title: Rating the first date: the hello, the laugh, the goodbye
old_caption: They invented the hug-shake, Sagittarius snorted cocoa twice, then asked for next week before Libra could finish the speech. The judges broke the scale. Rate your best first date moment.

title: Rating how they met my friends
old_caption: Capricorn walked in with snacks, got all four names right on the first try, and finished the pigeon-in-a-tiny-hat joke before anyone else could. The couch has spoken. How did your date do with your friends?
